title: Monorepo scaffold
story: As the dev team, we want web/, api/, kernel/ packages with shared lint/format and one compose file so every later story lands in a fixed structure.
acceptance: `docker compose up` starts proxy, web, api, worker, postgres; health endpoints return 200

title: CI pipeline
story: As the dev team, we want CI running unit, kernel and API tests on every merge request.
acceptance: Merge blocked when any test job fails; coverage report produced

title: Licence allow-list + SOUP list
story: As engineering, we want CI to fail on non-allow-listed licences and to generate a SOUP list from lockfiles.
acceptance: Adding a GPL package to a shipped lockfile fails CI; SOUP list lists name, version, licence for every dependency

title: Wording + i18n lint
story: As the product owner, we want CI to reject DEC-012 words, severity terms and hard-coded UI strings.
acceptance: Seeded forbidden word or hard-coded string fails CI; clean tree passes

title: Spike: clinic scans through K1 kernel
story: As the CTO, I want synthetic and phantom meshes (open head-like surfaces, sizes up to the expected clinic range) parsed, integrity-checked, closed with a plane+base and offset using trimesh/manifold3d, so stack risk RA-02 is measured without real patient data.
clinic_input_needed: — (no real scans; real-scan part moved to BL-134)
acceptance: Spike report on synthetic/phantom meshes: per mesh V/F, file size, parse time, closure success, offset self-intersection count, peak memory; provisional go/no-go on K1, confirmed by BL-134
v0.2_change: AUD-03: real scans removed from M0; AUD-03; AUD-03

title: Phantom generator
story: As QA, we want parametric synthetic meshes (sphere, ellipsoid, asymmetric ellipsoid, open-bottom variants, laterality marker) with analytic values.
acceptance: Generator outputs meshes + JSON of analytic CI/CVA/CVAI/HC, axes, marker side; reproducible by seed

title: Defect mesh catalogue
story: As QA, we want seeded-defect meshes (holes of set perimeter, non-manifold edge, self-intersection, fragments, flipped faces, corrupt/empty/oversize files, ghost layer).
acceptance: Each catalogue item has expected defect counts in a manifest

title: DB schema baseline + migrations
story: As engineering, we want the §5 domain tables with invariants INV-01…12 as constraints where possible.
acceptance: Migrations apply on empty DB; constraint tests for INV-01, -03, -05, -06, -11 pass; schema check finds no identity columns

title: Blob store (filesystem CAS + S3 adapter)
story: As engineering, we want put/get by SHA-256 with no overwrite/delete path.
acceptance: put twice → same SHA, one blob; no delete API; S3 adapter passes the same contract tests against a test bucket

title: Job queue + worker skeleton
story: As engineering, we want a Postgres job table with SKIP LOCKED claim, lease, heartbeat and 3-attempt retry for idempotent jobs.
acceptance: Killing worker mid-job → job re-queued after lease; non-idempotent job → failed; enqueue rolls back with its domain tx

title: Accounts, sessions, permission matrix
story: As a clinic admin, I want individual accounts with technician/admin roles enforced on every endpoint.
acceptance: Permission YAML drives route guards; generated role×action test matrix passes; login rate-limited; TLS-only

title: Audit module with hash chain
story: As a clinic admin, I want every state change logged in the same transaction with a tamper-evident chain.
acceptance: Rollback leaves no event; INSERT-only DB role; altering a row is detected by verify at that row

title: Create case + contents view
story: As a clinic admin, I want to open a case with a pseudonymous ID and see all linked objects.
acceptance: Unique ID J-xxxxxxxx; contents list shows type, version, creator, UTC time for N seeded objects

title: Upload STL + store original
story: As a technician, I want to upload an STL to a case; the original is stored byte-identical with its SHA-256.
acceptance: Binary + ASCII STL reference files give V/F equal to reference parser; corrupt/empty/oversize give distinct codes, case unchanged

title: Viewer with display LOD
story: As a technician, I want to see the scan in 3D (orbit, pan, zoom) using a display-only LOD in mm.
acceptance: jude-mesh/1 payload renders; LOD flagged display_only; kernel rejects LOD as op input (INV-10)

title: Unit confirmation + mm conversion
story: As a technician, I must confirm the file unit before any further step; bbox shown in mm.
acceptance: Downstream API returns UNIT_NOT_CONFIRMED until confirmed; ×10/×25.4/×1000 conversions exact; confirmation audited

title: Design op-log + closure/base op + save
story: As a technician, I want a design whose first op closes the scan with a base defined by explicit parameters, regenerated on the server and saved as an immutable version.
clinic_input_needed: UD-20 for real use (test values only here)
acceptance: New design has 0 ops; closure on open phantoms yields watertight solid; zero displacement above base plane; saved version immutable

title: Solid validity check
story: As a technician, I want the positive checked for boundary edges, non-manifold edges, self-intersections, components and normals.
acceptance: Every VER-08 defect type detected; clean phantoms pass; failing version not approvable

title: Minimal approve action (hash-bound)
story: As a technician, I want to approve a saved, valid version; approval binds geometry and parameter hashes.
acceptance: Admin → 403; approval stores geometry_sha + params_sha; edit after approval → new unapproved version

title: Export STL + re-import + minimal manifest
story: As a technician, I want to download a binary STL in mm with a manifest; the system re-reads the file before release.
acceptance: Unapproved/hash-mismatch export refused; corrupted-write injection → failed, not released; manifest SHA = file SHA

title: OBJ and PLY import
story: As a technician, I want to import OBJ (geometry only) and PLY (ASCII/binary) with notices for ignored textures/colour.
acceptance: Quads triangulated and reported; negative OBJ indices handled or rejected with code; colour/texture notice shown

title: Scan-to-case confirmation
story: As a technician, I must confirm that an uploaded scan belongs to the displayed case before it can be used.
acceptance: Unconfirmed scan → CASE_ASSOC_NOT_CONFIRMED on all downstream calls; one audit event per confirmation

title: Integrity report (full)
story: As a technician, I want counts of triangles, vertices, boundary loops + longest perimeter, non-manifold edges, degenerate faces, components, self-intersecting pairs and bbox.
acceptance: Each VER-08 seeded defect reported with correct count; ghost-layer mesh reports self-intersections > 0

title: Quality gate + logged override
story: As a technician, I want each metric compared with configured thresholds (block/warn) and to override a warn only with a reason ≥10 chars.
acceptance: Metric at threshold+1 triggers configured action; block stops flow; override without reason refused; override audited

title: Plausible size warning
story: As a technician, I want a warning when bbox (mm) is outside the configured plausible range.
acceptance: ×10 scaled mesh triggers warning; NOT_SET range shows 'check not configured'

title: Scan metadata
story: As a technician, I want to record device, software, operator, date, cap, posture, attempts, with explicit 'unknown'.
acceptance: Fields stored; 'unknown' explicit; locked after first measurement

title: Remove regions + undo/disable
story: As a technician, I want to select and remove non-head regions as recorded ops I can undo or disable.
acceptance: Disabling all cleanup ops reproduces original-mm hash; re-application gives identical hash

title: Fill selected holes
story: As a technician, I want to fill chosen boundary loops up to a perimeter I set; new faces are flagged synthetic.
acceptance: Loops ≤ set perimeter closed, larger untouched; synthetic flag set; measurements touching synthetic faces warn

title: Decimate as recorded op
story: As a technician, I want to reduce triangle count to a target with max displacement reported.
acceptance: Output within ±1% of target; displacement reported; manifold check after op

title: Clinic configuration (versioned)
story: As a technician or clinic admin, I want to draft and publish clinic configuration versions; controlled sections activate only after second-person approval (BL-125); nothing ships with production values.
acceptance: Publish creates version n+1 + audit event; objects reference config version; production DB refuses test_only config; NOT_SET keys produce CONFIG_NOT_SET

title: Landmark placement with server snap
story: As a technician, I want to place, move and delete the landmarks of the active frame definition; the server snaps them to the full-res surface.
acceptance: Stored landmark distance to surface < 1e-6 mm; snap distance > limit flags landmark

title: Frame computation, display and confirmation
story: As a technician, I want the anatomical frame, mid-sagittal plane and L/R labels shown, and must confirm before measuring or designing.
acceptance: Phantom axes match analytic within tolerance; det=+1; FRAME_NOT_CONFIRMED before confirm; laterality object keeps its side

title: Coverage check by sector
story: As a technician, I want to see which configured sectors above the reference plane lack surface data.
acceptance: Phantom with one sector removed reported for that sector only

title: Compute CI, CVA, CVAI, HC
story: As a technician, I want the four values computed under definitions I explicitly select, with both CVAI denominator variants available.
acceptance: Phantom values within VER-01 tolerance for each variant; DEFINITION_NOT_SELECTED without explicit choice; every value has 7 provenance fields; presets 30° and 40° in both denominator variants (DEC-027)

title: Value display with definition, plane, repeatability note
story: As a technician, I want each value shown with its definition label, plane/contour/diagonals rendered, and the repeatability text.
acceptance: Every value view shows definition; automated scan of outputs finds 0 definition-less values; 'repeatability not established locally' shown until VER-05

title: Supersession on landmark/frame change
story: As a technician, I want earlier measurement sets and designs marked superseded when landmarks or frame change.
acceptance: After landmark move: two sets exist, older superseded; dependent design not approvable

title: Provenance class + no classification
story: As the product owner, I want each value tagged with provenance class and no severity labels anywhere.
acceptance: Schema has provenance class; code search finds no index threshold constants; VER-09 passes

title: Edit op stack
story: As a technician, I want to edit, disable, re-enable, reorder and delete ops; each change regenerates and is logged.
acceptance: Disable+re-enable returns prior hash; each change one audit event

title: Uniform normal offset
story: As a technician, I want a uniform offset in mm with a purpose label (cap, liner, other), no default.
acceptance: Sphere r + d → radius r+d within tolerance; new design has no offset op; self-intersection → op rejected

title: Global axis / circumference adjustment
story: As a technician, I want A-P, M-L, vertical and circumference-at-level adjustments in mm.
acceptance: +x mm A-P changes A-P length by x within tolerance on phantom

title: Correction zones with categories
story: As a technician, I want circular/elliptical zones at an anchored centre with signed magnitude, extent, transition and a clinic category.
acceptance: Sphere phantom: max displacement m ±tol at centre, 0 beyond extent+transition; zone without category refused; overlapping zones refused while rule NOT_SET

title: Sign convention everywhere
story: As a technician, I want every control, the map legend and the manifest to state both the positive-surface direction and the device-space effect.
acceptance: VER-14 sign test passes in UI, deviation map and manifest

title: Out-of-range confirmation
story: As a technician, I want values outside configured ranges to require an explicit, logged confirmation.
acceptance: Out-of-range → OUT_OF_RANGE_UNCONFIRMED until confirmed; confirmation audited; in-range no prompt

title: Failed regeneration keeps last valid state
story: As a technician, I want a failing op shown as failed while the last valid geometry stays and cannot be saved over.
acceptance: Injected kernel failure leaves geometry hash unchanged; save → REGEN_FAILED

title: No defaults / no proposals audit
story: As the product owner, I want proof that no correction value is pre-filled or proposed.
acceptance: Op schemas contain no defaults for clinical/production params (schema test); UI fields start empty

title: Per-op cache + regeneration timing
story: As a technician, I want edits to the last op to recompute only from that op, and timings measured.
acceptance: Cache hit when upstream unchanged; p95 regen time recorded for N-triangle mesh; result feeds NFR-04 budget

title: Deviation map + per-zone stats
story: As a technician, I want a signed-distance colour map (mm) between positive and scan with legend and per-zone min/max/mean.
acceptance: Sphere+zone m: reported max = m within tolerance; legend matches stored field

title: Point query
story: As a technician, I want the signed distance at a picked point.
acceptance: Picked value equals stored field at that face/bary

title: Validity panel + geometry-only wording
story: As a technician, I want validity results labelled as geometric checks only.
acceptance: Label present on panel and in report; VER-09 passes

title: Full approval: checklist, self-approval, statement
story: As a technician, I want approval to require the configured checklist, bind scan/measurement refs, disclose self-approval and show the scope statement.
requirements: FR-090, FR-093, SAF-11, DATA-05, UR-04, FR-090 (5-item binding)
acceptance: Incomplete checklist → CHECKLIST_INCOMPLETE; self-approval statement in record and report; statement text stored verbatim; approval stores version ID, geometry hash, parameter-list hash, source scan hash and measurement set ID

title: Reject with reason
story: As a technician, I want to reject a version with a typed reason.
acceptance: Rejected version shows reason, user, time

title: Stale-source check
story: As a technician, I want a warning and logged confirmation when the case has a newer scan than the design's source.
acceptance: Two-scan case: approve/export on older scan → STALE_SOURCE_UNCONFIRMED until confirmed; one-scan case no prompt

title: Full manifest + schema + export frame
story: As production, I want the manifest with zones, offsets, effect statements, template, approval and re-import result, and STL in the configured export frame.
acceptance: Manifest validates against published schema; laterality object keeps side in exported STL

title: Re-import tolerance from config
story: As QA, I want the re-import check to use the configured tolerance and record max deviation.
acceptance: NOT_SET tolerance → CONFIG_NOT_SET; deviation recorded in export record

title: Russian PDF case report
story: As a clinic admin, I want a PDF with stored values + definitions, parameters, deviation image, validity, approval; no interpretation.
requirements: FR-110, FR-111, INT-06, UR-10, SAF-01 (report footer)
acceptance: Every value in PDF equals DB value; definition per value; Cyrillic correct in two PDF readers; VER-09 passes on template; approved SAF-01 statement in every report footer

title: Audit view, filters, CSV, verify
story: As a clinic admin, I want to filter the log by case/user/event/date, export UTF-8 CSV and run chain verification.
acceptance: Filtered CSV row count = view count; Cyrillic preserved; verify reports first broken link

title: Archive instead of delete
story: As a clinic admin, I want to archive cases; archived objects stay retrievable and read-only.
acceptance: No delete path in API; archived object not editable; archive of case with active approval blocked

title: Templates (save, apply, version)
story: As a technician, I want to save the op list as a named, versioned template and apply it to new designs.
acceptance: Template ops equal source; design records template id+version; older designs keep old version

title: Intended-use statement placements
story: As the product owner, I want the approved statement on sign-in, about screen and report footer.
acceptance: Statement present on sign-in and about screens; text matches approved version; report-footer placement is verified in BL-055

title: E2E suite on supported browsers + min-spec
story: As QA, I want UC-02…UC-10 automated on each listed browser at minimum hardware with the N-triangle mesh.
acceptance: Suite green on every listed browser; run time and memory recorded

title: Persistence, timestamps, precision
story: As QA, I want NFR-07, NFR-08, NFR-09 verified.
acceptance: 50/50 browser-kill trials keep committed ops; DB times UTC; display decimals follow config; build version on outputs

title: Permission + gate + audit completeness suites
story: As QA, I want VER-12 and VER-13 complete across all endpoints and event types.
acceptance: Every role×action pair and gate passes; every audit event type present; chain verifies

title: Backup/restore + deployment runbook
story: As operations, I want DB + blob backups and a tested restore on a clean host.
acceptance: Restore on clean host reproduces a case incl. hash re-verification of all blobs

title: Determinism regression on stored designs
story: As QA, I want nightly regeneration of all stored reference designs compared by hash.
acceptance: 100 regenerations of 10 reference designs → 1 hash each; a second host gives same hashes or documented tolerance

title: Enter clinic configuration
story: As the clinic technician, I want to enter and publish the clinic's definitions, landmarks, thresholds, categories, ranges, checklist, base and export conventions.
acceptance: No CONFIG_NOT_SET errors on the pilot workflow; config version recorded

title: Clinic file coverage
story: As QA, I want ≥3 anonymised clinic exports per format actually used imported and processed end-to-end.
acceptance: All files complete UC-02…UC-10

title: Physical phantom measurement
story: As QA + clinical lead, we want a known object scanned on the clinic's Artec Eva measured in Jude vs calliper/CAD.
acceptance: Report with differences against agreed limits

title: Rodin4D Neo import + value comparison
story: As production, I want Jude STLs imported into the clinic's Neo without repair prompts, and Jude vs Rodin4D values compared with definitions recorded.
acceptance: Neo import passes on clinic install (version recorded); comparison report on ≥10 scans

title: Physical positive check
story: As production, I want at least one positive made from a Jude export measured against the STL.
acceptance: Record exists with production-owned limits

title: Technician usability test vs success criterion
story: As the product owner, I want clinic technicians to run UC-02…UC-10 and measure against the OQ-B5 criterion.
acceptance: Completion, errors, time recorded; criterion met / not met stated

title: Pilot environment deployment
story: As operations, I want the pilot environment deployed on the chosen hosting with TLS, backups and monitoring.
acceptance: TLS scan clean; restore drill passed on pilot host

title: Follow-up encounters + multi-device episode
story: See requirement.
acceptance: Per RTM acceptance criteria

title: Scan-to-scan overlay with ICP (Open3D)
story: See requirement.
acceptance: Per RTM acceptance criteria

title: Trend table with definition warning + repeatability band
story: See requirement.
acceptance: Per RTM acceptance criteria

title: New scan vs approved positive map
story: See requirement.
acceptance: Per RTM acceptance criteria

title: Mirror reference overlay
story: See requirement.
acceptance: Per RTM acceptance criteria

title: Trim/marking curve + clearance checklist
story: See requirement.
acceptance: Per RTM acceptance criteria

title: Protected regions
story: See requirement.
acceptance: Per RTM acceptance criteria

title: Shell generation (SDF offset, thickness map)
story: See requirement.
acceptance: Per RTM acceptance criteria

title: 3MF export
story: See requirement.
acceptance: Per RTM acceptance criteria

title: Read-only shared review (needs privacy rules)
story: See requirement.
acceptance: Per RTM acceptance criteria

title: Client-side preview for zone edits (if QAS-06 fails)
story: See requirement.
acceptance: Per RTM acceptance criteria

title: Prescription reference attachment
story: See requirement.
acceptance: Per RTM acceptance criteria

title: Authentication and session hardening
story: As the product owner, I want argon2id passwords, login throttling, idle session expiry and CSRF tokens so that accounts protecting infant data cannot be taken over.
acceptance: SEC-05/06/20 acceptance criteria pass

title: Upload sandbox and limits
story: As engineering, we want uploads parsed only in the isolated worker with size, face, CPU and memory caps, non-root, read-only FS and no egress.
acceptance: Oversize, face-bomb and malformed fixtures rejected with codes; container inspection passes

title: Real-patient-data gate
story: As the product owner, I want uploads refused while real_patient_data_enabled is false, and the flag enabled only with an approved privacy decision ID and a second approver.
acceptance: REAL_DATA_DISABLED returned while false; enabling without decision ID or second approver refused; event logged

title: Consent reference and secondary-use permission
story: As a clinic admin, I want to record a consent reference (ID, date, scope) and the secondary-use permission (default not_permitted) before any scan is uploaded.
acceptance: Upload without consent reference returns CONSENT_REF_MISSING; permission defaults to not_permitted; changes logged

title: Scan outcome tag and structured reasons
story: As a technician, I want each scan tagged accepted / accepted_with_override / rescanned with a reason from the clinic list, and override/rejection reasons categorised.
acceptance: Tag and category stored with link to superseding scan; free text kept alongside

title: Landmark placement trail
story: As a technician, I want every placement and move of a landmark kept (hint, snapped face/bary, snap distance, user, time).
acceptance: History rows for each move; superseded positions retained

title: Reserve model-proposed provenance values
story: As the AI lead, I want provenance values model-proposed-accepted/edited reserved and never written by the MVP.
acceptance: Enum contains both values; test proves MVP code paths never write them

title: Retain removed-face sets
story: As the AI lead, I want removed-face sets of cleanup ops retained for the life of the case and re-mappable to original_sha.
acceptance: Re-mapping test reproduces removed set on the original mesh

title: UI session ID and reserved AI event names
story: As the AI lead, I want audit events to carry a UI session ID and the AI event type names reserved.
acceptance: Session ID present on UI-originated events; reserved names accepted by schema and unused

title: Optional cohort descriptors (conditional)
story: As the AI lead, I want optional age-at-scan (weeks), sex and referral pattern fields, built only if the owner and privacy specialist approve OQ-AI-02.
acceptance: Fields optional with explicit "not recorded"; VER-09 wording review of referral field

title: Read-access logging
story: As a clinic admin, I want every view or download of scans, display meshes, exports, reports and audit CSV logged.
acceptance: One read event per access with user, role, time, case, object

title: Controlled downloads
story: As the product owner, I want only released exports and reports of permitted cases downloadable, with pseudonymous file names and no bulk scan export.
acceptance: EXPORT_NOT_RELEASED / 403 cases pass; file-name pattern check passes

title: Versioned controlled configuration with re-approval
story: As the product owner, I want every change to checklist, gate thresholds, ranges, base/export conventions and tolerances versioned with a diff, disclosed in later approvals, and exports of designs approved under an older version blocked until re-approval.
acceptance: Version n+1 + diff + audit event; approval shows last change; REAPPROVAL_REQUIRED on outdated approval; optional second-person switch works

title: Prescription attachment bound to approval
story: As a technician, I want to attach the prescription file to the case and have approval bound to its SHA-256.
acceptance: PRESCRIPTION_MISSING without file; file byte-identical on download; reads logged; approval stores file SHA

title: Zone overlap rule gate
story: As a technician, I want overlapping zones refused until the clinic combination rule is set, and combined only by that rule afterwards.
acceptance: ZONE_OVERLAP_NOT_ALLOWED naming both zones

title: Scan metadata lock
story: As a technician, I want scan metadata locked after the first measurement, with corrections stored as linked entries.
acceptance: METADATA_LOCKED after first measurement; correction entry stored with reason

title: Backup and restore test
story: As engineering, we want DB and blob backups meeting RPO/RTO and a passing restore test before pilot.
acceptance: Daily DB + file-storage backups; restore test: chain + SHA verification pass; restore ≤ 24 h

title: Dependency vulnerability scan
story: As engineering, we want a vulnerability scan on every build that blocks releases at the agreed severity.
acceptance: Seeded vulnerable package fails release job

title: Privacy controls implementation
story: As the product owner, I want the deployment record (Supabase project and region), platform encryption statement and the erasure procedure in place before real data.
acceptance: SEC-10/11/13 acceptance criteria pass on the pilot deployment

title: Privacy documentation and inspection
story: As the privacy specialist, I want the data classification record, incident procedure and the VER-22 inspection completed before the first real scan.
acceptance: Signed VER-22 record; tabletop incident exercise record

title: Security suite, threat model review, account lifecycle
story: As QA, I want the VER-21 suite green on the pilot configuration and every threat mapped to a test or an accepted risk; deactivation and access review in place.
acceptance: VER-21 acceptance criteria met

title: Spike: real clinic scans through K1 kernel
story: As the CTO, I want ≥3 real Artec Studio exports processed as in BL-005, only after the real-patient-data gate is opened under VER-22.
clinic_input_needed: ≥3 clinic scans under approved privacy decisions
acceptance: Spike report as BL-005 on real scans; go/no-go on K1 confirmed

title: Local smoothing
story: As a technician, I want to smooth the positive only inside a region I select, with the deviation reported.
acceptance: Outside region bit-identical; deviation report matches independent computation

title: Agreement with manual measurements
story: As QA, I want Jude values compared with the clinic's manual measurements on pilot cases (bias, limits of agreement).
acceptance: Report per index with n, bias, LoA, methods
